user_summary.title: Calmer surfaces and smoother navigation
items: Sidebar labels stay on one line while collapsing; account and inbox controls sit at the bottom.
Dialogs support bounded desktop dragging and resizing, including keyboard resizing.
Warmer neutral surfaces, clearer login and home layouts, and better action spacing keep the blue KagNode accent.
